used_bytes.description: Sum of the domain's mailbox usage; null when no usage was read yet

quota_bytes_allocated.description: Sum of the mailboxes' quotas, a default quota counted as `quota_default_bytes`

max_mailboxes.description: At most this many mailboxes; null is unlimited

max_quota_bytes_total.description: At most this many quota bytes allocated in total; null is unlimited

role.description: The requester's role on this domain: `admin` (a server admin), `manager` or `viewer`.

usage_checked_at.description: ISO 8601, or null when usage was never read

code.description: Stable snake_case identifier the client switches on.
